package json

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type securityHidden struct{ Value string }
type securityHiddenString string

func TestSecurityEmbeddedUnexported(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("nil pointer", func(t *testing.T) {
		defer func() {
			if p := recover(); p != nil {
				t.Errorf("unexported pointer panicked: %v", p)
			}
		}()
		var dst struct{ *securityHidden }
		if err := Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Value":"x"}`), &dst); err == nil {
			t.Error("nil unexported embedded pointer accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("non-struct ignored", func(t *testing.T) {
		defer func() {
			if p := recover(); p != nil {
				t.Errorf("unexported field panicked: %v", p)
			}
		}()
		var dst struct{ securityHiddenString }
		if err := Unmarshal([]byte(`{"securityHiddenString":"x"}`), &dst); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
		if dst.securityHiddenString != "" {
			t.Error("unexported non-struct field changed")
		}
	})
	t.Run("value struct preserved", func(t *testing.T) {
		var dst struct{ securityHidden }
		if err := Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Value":"x"}`), &dst); err != nil || dst.Value != "x" {
			t.Errorf("exported embedded field lost: %v", err)
		}
	})
}
func TestSecurityNestingDepth(t *testing.T) {
	for _, n := range []int{10000, 10001} {
		var v interface{}
		err := Unmarshal([]byte(strings.Repeat("[", n)+"0"+strings.Repeat("]", n)), &v)
		if n == 10000 && err != nil {
			t.Errorf("at-limit depth rejected: %v", err)
		}
		if n > 10000 && err == nil {
			t.Error("excessive JSON nesting accepted")
		}
	}
}
